Our Turtle Friendly Wildlife Lighting is crafted as a wall-mounted lantern, built from solid copper and designed to age gracefully with a natural patina. It provides electric illumination for everyday exterior use and complements both traditional and coastal architecture.

• Certified wildlife-friendly design approved by the Florida Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission.
• Fully shielded, downward-directed illumination reduces light pollution in coastal environments.
• Handcrafted from solid copper for exceptional durability and natural corrosion resistance
• Engineered to meet stringent sea turtle lighting regulations for beachfront communities.
• Electric illumination provides reliable, low-impact lighting for residential and commercial exteriors.
• Ideal for waterfront properties, coastal developments, and wildlife-sensitive outdoor areas.
